name: swasira-monorepo
description: SWASIRA — Personalized Life-Stage Aware Health & Nutrition Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "#0B4F4A,#E9A23B" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
